description: This file defines the main settings view for a macOS application using SwiftUI. It includes a tabbed interface with various settings categories such as General, Channels, Voice Wake, Config, Instances, Sessions, Cron, Skills, Permissions, Debug, and About. The view manages state, handles notifications to switch tabs dynamically, and updates permissions monitoring based on the selected tab. It also contains UI components like banners and handles async tasks for permissions and snapshot paths.

classes.name: SettingsRootView
classes.description: The main view component rendering a tabbed settings interface, managing permissions, and reacting to notifications regarding tab changes and application state.

methods.name: validTab
methods.description: Ensures that the requested tab is valid given the current state, e.g., disables debug tab if not enabled.

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Async function to update the configuration and state directory paths from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Async function to refresh the permission monitor state.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Sets monitoring of permissions based on the currently selected tab.

methods.name: stopPermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Stops permission monitoring when view disappears.
